name: Tukumo 1
source:
When the Tsukumogami awaken from their slumber, a once-in-a-century battle beyond human comprehension will begin.

Kazuya Kusakabe, who awakened the white-haired divine girl, will also take up the sacred weapon, the Kikuichimonji, and throw himself into the battle.

Determined to protect the people he holds dear from the gods' conflict, he imagines a future where he will likely bleed, suffer pain, and be tormented by regret. Yet, despite all this, the boy resolves to gain the power he needs.

[Translated from DLSite]
translation:
付丧神从沉眠中苏醒之时，一场百年一遇、超乎人类理解的战争便将打响。

唤醒白发神女的日下部和弥也拿起神兵“菊一文字”，投身战场。

为了保护珍视之人免受众神争斗波及，他想象着等待自己的未来：流血、疼痛，以及悔恨的折磨。即便如此，少年仍下定决心，要获得自己所需的力量。

[译自DLsite]
